description: The Center for the Arts’ Fall Classes are back! From creative exploration to skill-building experiences, our arts education programs offer opportunities for kids, teens, and adults to learn, create, and connect. Whether your child is discovering a new passion or you’re finally making time for your own creativity, there’s a class waiting for you at The Center., Fall Classes at The Center run September 14 through November 20th!, The Center for the Arts invites the community to explore creativity this fall with a new season of arts education opportunities for youth and adults. Designed to inspire curiosity, confidence, and connection, The Center’s classes provide a welcoming space for participants to learn new skills and experience the joy of creating., As part of its ongoing commitment to making the arts accessible throughout Nevada County, The Center continues to expand opportunities for community members of all ages to participate in meaningful arts experiences. From first-time creators to lifelong artists, everyone has a place to explore at The Center.

Playwriting Group
description: All playwrights welcome! Whether playwriting is new to you or you're already an accomplished playwright, come join this on-going bi-weekly writers' group. We'll spend our time focusing on our writing, but with that magical element of doing so within the presence of others. Come discover the amazing experience of writing within the context of a group. Bring your computer, notebook, iPad, or whatever you like to use for writing. We share resources, discuss our goals and challenges, even provide feedback, but the primary focus of the group is to work on your own play! We'll do a check-in/discussion at the beginning of the meeting, then write in silence, and check-out at the end of our session. Contact Kimberly for the location and to answer any questions you may have. Category: Literary, Theater / Theatre

title: #socialsketch + #write_on
description: Join us First Friday + #SocialSketch from 5 - 8 pm! Spend the evening drawing, sketching, collaborating and socializing with other artists, casual doodlers and creatives. You can attend for the whole evening or you are welcome to come for just an hour. Bring your favorite sketchbook, notepad, pen, ink, and maybe coloring tools and enjoy a night of fun and make some new friends! We'll also be celebrating National Letter Writing month with @eggpress's #write_on campaign. If you aren't the doodler, we've got letter writing supplies and encourage you to take a little time out of your day to write a letter or two. We will take care of the postage! First 5 signups get a kit!

Paula Cole
description: Paula Cole returns to the stage with THIS FIRE: 30—a special anniversary tour celebrating three decades of This Fire. A Grammy-winning singer-songwriter known for her fearless writing and genre-blending sound, Cole broke boundaries with songs that were both deeply personal and universally resonant. On THIS FIRE: 30, Paula will perform This Fire in its entirety—revisiting the era-defining music that sparked a generation and bringing new life, nuance, and power to the songs fans have carried with them for decades. Expect an intimate, emotionally charged performance that honors the original spirit of the album while showcasing the artistry and perspective she’s continued to evolve.
